rules.semantic: A classic window gate (the soldier's check_special_ai) with no current foe first acquires the nearest foe and KEEPS it as the walker's foe; when there is still no foe to be found the gate is closed (no special).

arms.observable: foe unchanged; gate answers by the window (see ai.lua:36)

arms.when: no foe, a foe is findable
arms.observable: self:foe() afterwards == the nearest foe (side effect visible even when the window then says false)
gate returns false; foe stays nil

missing_arms: no foe, a foe is findable
note: No test asserts the foe after a gate call, and no test calls the classic soldier gate with nobody findable.

rules.anchor: return distance < far and distance > near
rules.semantic: The soldier's classic special gate fires only for a foe strictly inside the open window (near, far) = (20, 75) px of distance_to_ob (corner-to-corner Manhattan); a foe at exactly 20 or 75, nearer, or farther gets no special.

tests.note: gate(soldier,1,0): 40, 50, 70 px true; 19 and 76 px false

note: Both closed edges are named in the arms (exactly 20 and exactly 75) and no test stands a foe at 20 or 75: a mutation to distance <= far or distance >= near survives (19/76 are one past the edge).
